declaration.preface:
Quality Rubbers is committed to upholding fundamental labor standards and respecting human rights across all its operations and business relationships. The Company recognizes that responsible labor practices and respect for human dignity are essential to sustainable business performance and long-term value creation.

This policy establishes the Company’s intent to promote fair, safe, and inclusive working conditions while ensuring that all employees are treated with dignity, respect, and equality. It reflects the organization’s commitment to preventing human rights violations, including forced labor, child labor, discrimination, harassment, and any form of unfair or unethical treatment.

The policy aims to guide the organization in creating a work environment that supports employee well-being, encourages diversity and equal opportunity, and fosters open communication and mutual respect. It also extends to suppliers and business partners, encouraging alignment with responsible labor practices throughout the value chain.

Through this policy, Quality Rubbers seeks to strengthen its approach to labor and human rights by integrating ethical practices into daily operations, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and standards, and continuously improving its performance in line with recognized global principles.

declaration.scope:
This policy applies to all employees, workers (including permanent, temporary, and contract workers), directors, officers, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of Quality Rubbers. It also extends to suppliers, service providers, and business partners across the value chain.

The policy covers all aspects of the Company’s operations, including sourcing, processing, storage, handling, transportation, and distribution activities, as well as all interactions with employees, customers, suppliers, regulatory authorities, and other stakeholders.

focusAreas: Prevention of Child and Forced Labor

Fair Employment Practices: Fair Employment Practices: We aim to ensure fair and transparent employment practices, including equal opportunity, non-discrimination, and merit-based hiring and advancement.
Prevention of Child and Forced Labor: Prevention of Child and Forced Labor: We aim to strictly prohibit child labor, forced labor, bonded labor, and any form of involuntary employment across operations.
Workplace Health and Safety: Workplace Health and Safety: We aim to provide a safe and healthy working environment by identifying risks, implementing preventive measures, and promoting a strong safety culture.
Wages and Benefits: Wages and Benefits: We aim to ensure fair compensation, including payment of wages and benefits in compliance with applicable laws and industry standards.
Working Hours and Conditions: Working Hours and Conditions: We aim to maintain reasonable working hours, adequate rest periods, and humane working conditions in line with legal requirements.
Freedom of Association: Freedom of Association: We aim to respect employees’ rights to freedom of association and collective representation in accordance with applicable laws.
Career Development and Training: Career Development and Training: We aim to support employee growth through fair access to training, skill development, and career advancement opportunities.
Prevention of Discrimination and Harassm: Prevention of Discrimination and Harassment: We aim to ensure a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, abuse, or any form of unfair treatment, and promote a culture of dignity and respect.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: We aim to promote diversity and foster an inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with fairness, dignity, and respect.

policy.monitoring:
At Quality Rubbers, continuous improvement is embedded within our environmental management approach to ensure sustained progress and long-term impact. We regularly review and strengthen our environmental practices to respond to evolving regulatory requirements, operational needs, and sustainability priorities.

Performance Tracking: Key labor and human rights parameters, including workforce composition, training coverage, working hours, health and safety performance, and compliance indicators, are regularly monitored against defined performance metrics.

Periodic Reviews: Labor and human rights data is reviewed at defined intervals to assess progress, identify gaps, and support informed decision-making and corrective actions.

Internal Audits: Periodic internal audits and assessments are conducted to evaluate compliance with applicable labor laws, internal policies, and ethical standards.

Data Integrity and Documentation: Accurate records and documentation systems are maintained to ensure reliability, consistency, and traceability of workforce-related data.

Stakeholder Engagement: Engagement is maintained with employees, management, and relevant stakeholders to address concerns, strengthen transparency, and promote responsible labor practices.

Performance Disclosure: Labor and human rights performance, along with key initiatives, is communicated through internal reporting systems and external disclosures, where applicable.

Through these efforts, Quality Rubbers integrates continuous improvement into its core operations, ensuring that labor and human rights practices remain effective, adaptive, and aligned with evolving regulatory requirements and organizational commitments.

policy.reviewMechanism:
The Fair Labor and Human Rights Policy is subject to periodic review to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with applicable labor laws, human rights standards, and organizational objectives.

The Human Resources Manager is responsible for coordinating the policy review process.

The policy is reviewed at least once every year or earlier, if required, based on regulatory changes, operational requirements, or stakeholder feedback.

The review process includes assessment of compliance with labor and human rights requirements, evaluation of workforce practices, and review of progress against defined performance indicators and targets.

Necessary updates and revisions are implemented to strengthen the policy and ensure alignment with best practices, international labor standards, and continuous improvement principles.
